definitions.explanation: The amount subtracted from income or a payment, especially in tax and insurance contexts, such as a standard deduction or a dependent allowance.

examples.japanese: {控除額|こうじょがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
⟦{扶養|ふよう}{控除|こうじょ}→扶養控除：23325_fuyoukoujo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{控除額|こうじょがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The amount of the dependent deduction has changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}→医療費控除：23316_iryouhikoujo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{控除額|こうじょがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{支払|しはら}った→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The amount of the medical-expense deduction is determined by how much you paid.

notes:
The sum that is deducted, used mainly in tax and insurance. Built from ⟦{控除|こうじょ}→控除：07501_koujo⟧ (deduction) and ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount, sum).
